connectionFailed.title: Can't Connect to the Server
connectionFailed.hint: The server may be restarting or the network may be down. Try again in a moment.

projectUnavailable.title: Can't Open the Project
projectUnavailable.hint: The project may not be registered, its folder may be unavailable, or the server may be stopping. Retry, or continue without a project.

incompatible.title: Page and Server Versions Don't Match
incompatible.hint: Reload the page to load the version that matches the server.

startupFailed.title: The Workbench Failed to Start
startupFailed.hint: Reload the page to try again. If it still fails, check the server log.

serverRestarted.title: The Server Restarted
serverRestarted.hint: Reload the page to reconnect to the server.

projectGone.title: The Project Was Closed
projectGone.hint: The project was closed on the server (no window used it for a while, it exited unexpectedly, or the server restarted). Reload the page to reopen it, or continue without a project.

rescued.title: Unsaved Changes
rescued.hint: Copy the text below before reloading. It won't be kept after the reload.

offline.banner: The connection to the server was lost. Reconnecting…
